scientific_question: Does adding explicit observation-only multi-view reprojection consistency to proposal-level G improve correspondence selection beyond frozen V5 descriptor-G + full-pair global-address R on family-disjoint cal16, without changing proposal support, R, F/D, or collapsing geometry?
causal_hypothesis: The current raster front door contains useful geometry in the top-k proposal graph, but descriptor-only G fails to expose multi-view physical consistency to the proposal-level global solver. A deterministic geometry-grounded G factor should recover additional correct correspondences while R remains unchanged.

development_evidence_only.surface: already-open dev e01 eight-family Rank2 panel
development_evidence_only.use: post-hoc hypothesis formation only; no threshold/weight fitting

prospective_surface.truth_policy: No sidecar semantic read until all 16 raster-only proposal-evidence files and G1/V5 selections are frozen and hashed.

frozen_inputs.proposal_extractor: exact V3-A top4 global-B-foreground descriptor extractor semantics
frozen_inputs.v5_r_semantics: full same-view all-visible-pair global relational address
frozen_inputs.v5_solver: maximum-real-matching cardinality K; 16 deterministic restarts; strict-descent move/swap/real-abstain exchange

controlled_change.name: proposal-level G only
controlled_change.v5_G: stable rank of descriptor score descending within each carrier/view proposal row
controlled_change.g1_geometry_raw: For each proposal q in carrier/view row: enumerate q paired with every proposal in every other usable view; frozen orthographic rank>=3 triangulation; reject nonfinite or abs(xyz)>0.75; evaluate mean nearest-proposal reprojection over all usable views; re-triangulate from all nearest proposals and re-evaluate; keep lexicographically best (mean reprojection ASC, support<=4px DESC, support<=2px DESC, mean descriptor support DESC).
controlled_change.g1_geometry_rank: stable rank of g1_geometry_raw mean reprojection ascending within carrier/view row
controlled_change.objective: E = mean(G1_G_cost over real assignments) + mean(V5 full-pair R over real-assigned pairs)

explicitly_forbidden: sidecar semantic access before selection freeze
XYZ point collapse or new geometry output
pretruth_gates: all cal16 e01 raster inputs exist and are hash inventoried
proposal evidence contains only raster/model-derived arrays and truth_access=NONE
V5 R pair-factor parity test passes on fixed synthetic and dev replay
geometry projection/triangulation parity with frozen v5_seed_geometry_frozen.py <= 1e-4 px / 1e-6 xyz
independent K parity, injectivity, objective recomputation, deterministic repeat pass
all cal16 V5 baseline and G1 assignments frozen before truth

evaluation.primary_rows: all reliable truth-visible carrier/view rows for which the frozen proposal row is nonempty
comparators: frozen-formula V5 full-pair R with descriptor G
G1 geometry-grounded G + unchanged V5 R
evaluation.observable_disagreement_stratum: pretruth rows where descriptor-rank top proposal differs from geometry-rank top proposal
evaluation.failure_rule: If any primary pass-rule item fails, G1 is FAIL as formulated. No same-surface retune.

next_if_pass: Preregister G2: add observation-only reciprocal/cycle correspondence to G while preserving G1 geometry and V5 R; then test on a separately frozen surface before sealed qualification.
next_if_fail: Do not rescue G1 on cal16. Move to a new learned camera-aware cross-view proposal-fusion treatment (MV-TAP/V-DPM style), with G1 explicit geometry retained as deterministic authority, on a new preregistered split.
sota_design_lineage: MapAnything: explicit calibration/ray/pose inputs instead of rediscovering known cameras
MV-TAP: camera-ray embedding + time/view/space attention + visibility/confidence iterative tracking
V-DPM: target-time-conditioned frame/global attention for geometric persistence
GGPT: explicit match/cycle/epipolar/triangulation/reprojection geometric authority before learned 3D refinement
